connections.why: Scarcity forces the allocation decisions that markets resolve through price
How price is set depends on the structure of the market
Cost and revenue curves drive firm behaviour in each market structure
Markets fail when price fails to capture the full social cost or benefit
Labour-market outcomes determine the employment objective
AD/AS analysis explains how the macro objectives are achieved
Policy instruments are the tools used to hit the macro objectives
Government intervention to correct market failure is a microeconomic policy
The circular flow includes exports and imports from international trade
Comparative advantage drives the globalisation of trade and investment
FDI and trade are key channels for economic development
Development relies on appropriate fiscal, monetary and supply-side policy
Scarce resources give rise to the costs firms face in production
The balance of payments is a macro objective shaped by trade
